title: Wayfare Rentals Class Eligibility, Hubs and Reservation Terms
content:
Who may rent each Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) class, which hub serves each market, and the reservation terms that apply to every class.

## Entry gate by vehicle class

Each class is open to a driver whose driver services agreement is active, is one of the agreements listed for that class, and who has reached the minimum driver age.

| Vehicle class | Driver services agreement status | Eligible driver services agreements | Minimum driver age |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan | Active | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement | 21 |
| Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan | Active | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement; Wayfare Green Driver Agreement | 21 |
| Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan | Active | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement; Wayfare Green Driver Agreement; Wayfare Comfort Driver Agreement | 21 |
| Wayfare Rentals Midsize SUV | Active | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement; Wayfare Comfort Driver Agreement | 21 |
| Wayfare Rentals Minivan | Active | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement; Wayfare XL Driver Agreement | 21 |
| Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan | Active | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement; Wayfare Comfort Driver Agreement; Wayfare Black Driver Agreement | 25 |

## Hub serving each market

The same hubs serve every class.

| Market | Hub |
|---|---|
| DEN | DEN central |
| COS | COS north |
| SLC | SLC downtown |
| PHX | PHX tempe |
| TUS | TUS midtown |
| LAS | LAS paradise |
| ABQ | ABQ uptown |

## Reservation terms common to every class

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Reservation hold for pickup | 3 calendar days, after which the reservation lapses |
| Fee to reserve a vehicle | $0.00 |
| Most rentals one driver may hold in reserved, active or return due status | 1 |
| May a driver with an unpaid balance on an earlier rental reserve a new one | No |
| Vehicle swap at the hub | Keeps the same rental and week; only the plate changes |

## Reading the gate: hypothetical drivers

- A driver aged 23 holding an active Wayfare Comfort Driver Agreement meets the gate of the Electric Sedan and the Midsize SUV, but not the Premium Sedan, whose minimum age is 25, and not the Economy Sedan, Hybrid Sedan or Minivan, which do not list that agreement.
- A driver holding an active Wayfare XL Driver Agreement meets the agreement column only for the Wayfare Rentals Minivan.
- A driver whose Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement is not active meets the gate of no class.
